subject: Re: Kickoff: MobileBERT on-device NLU — staffing + compute
body:
Hi Priya,

Staffing: Vera Egede 40% leads the fine-tuning and distillation work; Efe Lindqvist 30% on eval quality; Amara Okafor 40% on the tf.lite conversion and device-farm automation; Milan Zapata 30% on the serving-side fallback path for devices below the memory floor.

Compute is locked: we hold the vulcan-h100 reservation — 512 accelerators for the week of 2026-07-06 — for the final distillation-and-finetune sweep, and I've built the July schedule backward from that week. Everything earlier (SQuAD V1.1 reproduction at learning rate 4e-05, doc stride 128, per the released config) runs on titan-a100 best-effort, 64 GPUs.

Note I kept us clear of the Vulcan maintenance window in late June — reservation starts the week after.

One ask: the device farm needs 6 more mid-tier handsets to make the int8 latency numbers representative. ~$4k, coming to you for signoff.

Bruno
